introduction.zh: 你怎样看待自己的好奇、守诺、关心、审慎和其他日常倾向？本版逐条使用IPIP官方96条IPIP-VIA-R短版英文题与正反向键，提供费马独立中文试译和24份完整解释。结果记录本次自述，包含具体例子、取舍、对话与可选小观察，不把积极词语变成人品等级，也不把自认能力当成实际表现。可先阅读全部公开结果，再决定是否作答。
introduction.en: How do you describe your curiosity, promise-keeping, care, caution and other everyday tendencies? This edition uses the official 96-item IPIP-VIA-R English short key with FermatMind’s independent Chinese trial translation and 24 full educational guides. Results record this attempt through concrete examples, tradeoffs, dialogue and optional observations. Positive labels do not create moral ranks, and perceived ability is not demonstrated performance. Read every public guide first if you wish.

instructions.zh: 按你目前通常的实际情况，而非理想中的自己，选择每条描述多符合你：1很不符合、2比较不符合、3介于符合与不符合之间、4比较符合、5非常符合。英文沿用IPIP短语，不是能力考试；有些条目问到你对别人看法的印象，并未向别人核实。涉及私人信念、不愿回答或无法判断，可选NA。全部96条先作选择，各项四条全部有效才显示该项分数；不愿回答不扣分，也不会隐藏完整说明。
instructions.en: Rate how accurately each phrase describes you as you generally are now, rather than your ideal self: 1 Very inaccurate, 2 Moderately inaccurate, 3 Neither inaccurate nor accurate, 4 Moderately accurate, 5 Very accurate. English retains IPIP phrases, not ability-test questions. Some concern your impression of others’ views, which have not been checked with them. Use NA for private beliefs, voluntary nonresponse or inability to judge. Make all 96 selections; a part requires all four valid ratings for its score. Declining brings no penalty and never hides a full guide.

paragraphs.en: The four items concern feeling cared for, expressing love, sharing feelings and accepting care. They combine personal expression with experiences of the relationships available to you; they cannot all be reduced to individual capacity. This questionnaire obtains your account without verifying another person’s feelings or whether a relationship is safe or should continue.

paragraphs.en: You could say, “Thank you for thinking of me. I’d like to rest alone tonight; could we talk at the weekend?” Or, “Help would be welcome, but I don’t want to discuss the details.” Care and privacy can coexist. The other person also has choices; repeated giving must not become a demanded proof of love.

These frameworks may suggest different conversations, but scores cannot convert between them or establish attachment types, compatibility or a relationship’s prospects.

The last also depends on work arrangements, so this is not a performance test. Preference for independence, coordination skills and trust in a particular group require separate examination rather than a certificate of being a good teammate.

paragraphs.en: A higher mean reflects stronger endorsement of support and group-work descriptions. title.en: Fairness Character Strength: Full Result Guide

description.zh: 比较平等权利、个人好恶和实际安排，结合费用分配例子读自评；均分不认证公正或裁决谁对谁错。
description.en: Read equality, preferences and practical arrangements through a shared-cost example. Full comparisons and limits without a moral or legal verdict.

paragraphs.zh: 四条涉及平等对待、权利的重要性、占别人便宜，以及因不喜欢某人而区别对待。它们记录你如何评价自己，没有独立查看真实决策或受影响者的经验。自认公平与安排实际产生怎样的影响，是两个需要分别核对的问题。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern equal treatment, the importance of rights, taking advantage and treating disliked people differently. They record how you see yourself without independently examining a decision or the experiences of people affected by it. Seeing yourself as fair and establishing an arrangement’s actual effects are separate questions requiring different evidence.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可平等和不偏私的描述；较低可能提示你对某些题目有保留，值得回到具体例子。不能据此判好坏，也不能认为高分就没有偏见。不同题目可能反映不同处境，例如同意权利平等，却发现自己对熟人更宽容。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean reflects stronger endorsement of equality and impartial treatment; a lower one may identify statements you hesitate to endorse and want to examine concretely. Neither yields a moral verdict, and high endorsement does not establish freedom from bias. You might affirm equal rights while noticing more lenience toward someone familiar.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，几个人共同购买聚餐食材。有人没有使用某种昂贵食材，有人承担了额外采购。公平讨论可以先说明费用构成、事先约定和参与条件，再共同决定分法。直接平均并不自动公平，事后按喜好随意减免也需要解释和一致规则。
paragraphs.en: Suppose several people buy ingredients for a meal. One person cannot use an expensive ingredient, while another did extra shopping. A fairness discussion can make costs, prior agreements and participation conditions visible before choosing an allocation. An equal split is not automatically equitable, and discretionary discounts based on liking need a consistent explanation.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我们先列出实际使用和提前说好的部分，再看这次怎样分比较合适；同样情况也按同一规则处理。”对方可以提出遗漏条件。这样的对话把原则变成可以检查的安排，不用宣布自己最公正，也不靠问卷分数压过不同意见。
paragraphs.en: You could say, “Let’s list what was actually used and what we agreed beforehand, then choose a split we would also apply in a similar situation.” Others can identify missing conditions. This makes a principle inspectable without declaring yourself the fairest person or using a questionnaire score to outweigh disagreement.

paragraphs.zh: 公平与善意助人不同：给熟人多一点照顾可能出于善意，但仍需考虑其他人的权益。宽恕倾向讨论对过往不快的回应，也不取代公平的程序或责任安排。把几个问题分开，可以一面尊重具体需要，一面说明适用于相似情况的原则。
paragraphs.en: Fairness differs from kindness: offering extra help to a friend may express care while still raising questions about others’ interests. Forgiveness concerns responses to past wrongs and does not replace procedures or accountability. Keeping the questions separate allows attention to particular needs alongside an explanation that also applies to comparable circumstances.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，为了让不同参与者都能使用同一服务，可能需要不同形式的支持；这不必解释为偏心。相反，一句“对所有人都一样”也可能忽略真实障碍。本部分四条无法评估复杂制度、法律责任或争议事实，不能替代相关资料和当事人的声音。
paragraphs.en: Different forms of support may be needed for people to use the same service; that need not amount to favoritism. Conversely, saying “the same for everyone” may overlook real barriers. These four items cannot assess complex systems, legal responsibilities or disputed facts, and cannot replace relevant information or the accounts of people affected.

paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，回想一次低风险的资源分配，写下原规则、谁受到影响、一个可能遗漏的条件，以及同样情况能否一致处理。先核事实，不为小观察重新裁决重大争议。记录的作用是让回答更具体，不证明你已消除偏见或获得公正能力。

description.en: Read future expectations, worries and practical choices through a full example. No success prediction, positivity requirement or diagnosis.

paragraphs.zh: 四条围绕在不利情境中看见积极面、面对挑战仍抱希望、预期最坏情况，以及反复想到不太可能的负面结果。它们没有直接测目标规划、资源或实际成功。因此这里的希望与乐观是这些有限描述的自评，不代表完整的希望理论或行动能力。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern finding positives in difficult situations, remaining hopeful, expecting the worst and thinking about unlikely negative outcomes. They do not directly measure planning, resources or success. Hope and optimism here refer to these limited self-descriptions rather than a complete theory of hope or a demonstrated capacity for action.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示更认可希望与积极预期描述；较低可能与现实困难、近期挫折、谨慎措辞或持续担忧有关。具体风险值得具体处理，不能为了显得积极就否认。也不应因四条评分就诊断焦虑、抑郁，或把一个人的前途排成等级。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of hopeful and positive expectations. Lower endorsement may relate to real difficulties, recent setbacks, cautious wording or persistent worry. Specific risks deserve specific attention rather than denial for the sake of positivity. Four ratings cannot diagnose anxiety or depression or rank the prospects of someone’s life.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你提交了一份普通活动申请，还没有收到回复。你可以期待有机会，也可以承认结果未知，并查看公开的回复时间。先确认是否需要补材料，比仅凭“我感觉会成”或“肯定没希望”安排全部后续更具体；但问卷没有检验你会怎样行动。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you have submitted an application for an ordinary activity and await a reply. You can hope for an opening while acknowledging uncertainty and checking the published response date. Confirming whether anything is missing is more concrete than organising everything around “it will work” or “there’s no chance.” The questionnaire does not test that action.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我希望能参加，现在还不知道结果。我先确认材料齐全，再保留另一个可接受的安排。”这把愿望、已知事实和可控动作分开。对方感到担忧时，也不用要求其立即乐观；听清正在担心什么，可能比替其保证结局更合适。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I hope I can take part, but I don’t know the outcome yet. I’ll check the submission and keep another acceptable plan available.” This separates a wish, known facts and controllable actions. When someone is worried, understanding the concern may be more appropriate than demanding optimism or guaranteeing an outcome.

paragraphs.zh: 希望与坚持完成可以一起出现，也可以不同：期待好结果不保证持续行动，持续行动也可能伴随担忧。与行动前审慎相比，本部分强调未来预期，另一部分更涉及后果和选择。把三者分开，比假设乐观的人天然敢冒险或更会规划准确。
paragraphs.en: Hope and perseverance can coexist or differ: expecting a good outcome guarantees no sustained action, and sustained action can accompany worry. Compared with prudence, these items emphasise expectations rather than consequences and choices. Separating the questions is more accurate than assuming an optimistic person naturally takes risks or plans more effectively.

paragraphs.en: The four items concern using laughter to brighten others’ days, retaining humor in gloomy situations and being known as humorous or enjoyable company. The latter remain your account of others’ views, not collected observer ratings. They test neither joke writing, stage performance nor every humor style, and cannot establish another person’s comfort.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可这些轻松和幽默描述；较低也许意味着你比较认真、偏好不同笑点或不习惯评价自己是否有趣。安静地欣赏幽默和公开逗人笑可能不同。一个均分无法区分这些形式，尤其不能把没有表演式幽默当成社交缺陷。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of these playful and humorous descriptions. Lower endorsement may involve a serious style, different tastes or reluctance to call yourself entertaining. Quietly appreciating humor can differ from making people laugh publicly. A single mean cannot distinguish these forms or turn a lack of performative humor into a social deficit.

paragraphs.en: Imagine an empty cardboard box folding crookedly while you prepare a meal. It resembles an odd hat, and you show it to someone who wants to look before returning to the task. paragraphs.en: You could say, “This box looks like a hat to me; I found it funny. You’re busy, so let’s clear the table first.” Stop if the other person finds it unwelcome. Even jokes about objects or your own mishaps call for attention to responses; humor is no exemption from responsibility or permission to continue offending.

paragraphs.en: Humor may notice unexpected connections, as curiosity sometimes does, without requiring further investigation. FermatMind’s separate humor-style reflection explores different contexts of use and cannot be converted from these four ratings. Someone can endorse playfulness while listening seriously during an important conversation, without becoming responsible for entertaining every group they join.

paragraphs.en: The four items ask about stopping before completion, finishing despite obstacles, leaving started tasks unfinished and giving up easily. They generalise across tasks without checking whether goals remain appropriate, completion is defined or resources exist. Reported persistence cannot substitute for work performance or establish that every goal deserves continued effort regardless of its cost.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可持续和完成的描述；较低可能与任务过多、临时变化、缺少支持或主动调整有关。一个人可以认真推进一件重要事，同时停止几件不再合适的事。均分不区分所有原因，不能把休息或改变方向自动算成失败。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of persistence and completion. Lower endorsement may involve too many tasks, changing circumstances, inadequate support or deliberate adjustment. paragraphs.zh: 例如，你想整理一小盒散乱的配件，先约定只按用途分三袋。进行到一半发现缺少标签，你可以临时写纸条，也可以明确暂停到拿到材料。是否继续，应看目标、成本和实际条件，而不是为了证明自己有毅力而把整间房间都翻乱。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you want to organise a small box of fittings into three bags by use. Halfway through, labels are missing. You could write temporary slips or make a clear pause until materials are available. Continuing depends on the goal, cost and conditions rather than emptying the whole room to prove that you have persistence.

paragraphs.en: You might say, “Finishing this box is enough today. I’ll note the missing labels; the other cupboards are outside this task.” If the task no longer helps, explain why you are stopping. Naming the next step and endpoint makes the arrangement understandable without concluding that you lack persistence or must never quit.

paragraphs.zh: 坚持完成与热爱学习不同：有些人持续完成必要任务，却不享受学习新知识。自我调节更涉及冲动和长短期取舍，也不能从坚持均分推得。与拖延情境自评比较时，可以关注任务怎样开始和怎样继续，但几个分数不互换，更不解释全部原因。
paragraphs.en: Perseverance differs from love of learning: someone may finish necessary work without enjoying new knowledge. Self-regulation concerns urges and short-versus-longer-term choices and cannot be inferred from this mean. paragraphs.en: Canceling an outdated plan after new information, resting for health or stopping an unsafe task can be appropriate decisions. Continuing also guarantees no correct direction. description.en: Explore weighing options, evidence and uncertainty through an everyday choice. No IQ, decision-accuracy or professional-qualification verdict.

paragraphs.zh: 四条包括权衡利弊、朋友看重自己的判断，以及是否批判性思考和考虑不同可能。它们询问习惯与自我印象，没有提供需要解答的推理题，也没有核查朋友的真实看法。因此均分不是逻辑能力、智商、决策正确率或专业判断资格。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern weighing pros and cons, friends valuing your judgment, critical consideration and considering possibilities. They ask about habits and impressions without presenting reasoning problems or verifying friends’ views. A mean therefore measures neither logical ability, IQ, decision accuracy nor qualifications to make professional judgments on someone else’s behalf.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可权衡和考虑可能性的描述；较低可能与依赖熟悉经验、题目措辞或当前没有精力比较有关。你可以在某类事情上仔细、另一类上快速处理。考虑得久不保证正确，迅速作出的决定也不必然草率；需要看资料、代价和实际过程。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean means stronger endorsement of deliberation and alternatives. Lower endorsement may involve familiar routines, wording or limited energy for comparison. You may deliberate in one area and respond quickly in another. Taking longer guarantees no correctness, and speed need not imply carelessness; evidence, consequences and the actual process still matter.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你要为书桌选一只普通收纳盒。可以先确定尺寸、已有空间和预算，再比较两个可用选项，而不是收集无限多评价。若某个关键尺寸未知，就把它标作未知。这里讨论如何组织信息，不把是否买到最优物件当成性格考试。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you need an ordinary storage box for your desk. Establish dimensions, available space and budget, then compare two workable options instead of gathering endless reviews. Mark an unknown measurement as unknown. The example concerns organising information rather than treating the purchase of an optimal object as a character examination you must pass.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“目前知道这两个都放得下，一个便于拿取，另一个更省空间；重量我还没查。”这样的说明区分事实、取舍和缺口。也可以预先决定何时停止比较。别人提出新的相关信息时，可以修改决定，不需要维护“我的判断总是好”的形象。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “Both fit; one is easier to reach into, while the other saves space. I haven’t checked the weight.” This separates facts, tradeoffs and gaps. You can decide when to stop comparing. New relevant information can change the choice without threatening an image that your judgment must always be good.

paragraphs.zh: 审慎判断与行动前审慎有交集，但后者更直接涉及风险和后果；整体视角则询问对人生和重要事情的看法。三个均分都不能认证智慧。也不要把对熟悉流程的快速选择解释成缺少开放性，或把持续怀疑自动视为更高质量的思考。
paragraphs.en: Judgment overlaps with prudence, whose items more directly concern risks and consequences. Perspective asks about views of life and what matters. None certifies wisdom. A quick choice within a familiar procedure need not indicate closed-mindedness, and continuing to doubt is not automatically higher-quality thinking or evidence of a better decision.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，一个认真权衡的人可能使用了错误资料；一个话不多的人可能依靠相关经验作出合适选择。四条无法核对领域知识、消息可靠性或实际结果。涉及健康、法律、金钱等重要问题时，所需的是相应事实和资质，不能由这里的高均分替代。
paragraphs.en: Someone can weigh options carefully using incorrect information, while a quiet person can make an appropriate choice from relevant experience. Four items cannot verify domain knowledge, source reliability or outcomes. Consequential health, legal or financial questions require the corresponding facts and expertise; higher endorsement here cannot supply them or replace that examination.

paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，记录一次低成本、可撤回选择的两条已知事实、一个未知和最终取舍。之后只核对那个未知是否影响了决定，不必为每件小事制作复杂表格。一次选择成功或失败，都不足以证明稳定判断能力，也不要求以后总是慢慢决定。
paragraphs.en: If you wish, record two known facts, one unknown and the tradeoff in a low-cost, reversible choice. summary.en: Read enjoyment of learning and nonfiction through an ordinary tool example, distinguishing curiosity, persistence and available resources from academic ability.

title.zh: 热爱学习：兴趣、渠道与负担｜性格优势完整结果
title.en: Love of Learning: Character Strength Guide

description.zh: 围绕学习新事物与非虚构阅读的四条自评，比较好奇和坚持，结合日常工具说明，不测学历或学习能力。
description.en: Explore enjoyment of learning across accessible forms. Compare curiosity and persistence without literacy, academic-ability or grade judgments.

paragraphs.zh: 四条询问是否自认终身学习者、学到新东西的兴奋、不喜欢学新东西，以及不为乐趣阅读非虚构书籍。最后一项只涉及一种渠道，不能代表全部学习。手把手练习、听讲、交流和其他可访问形式，同样可能构成丰富经验；这里没有测掌握程度。
paragraphs.en: The four items ask about being a lifelong learner, excitement at learning, disliking new learning and not reading nonfiction for fun. The last concerns only one medium and cannot represent all learning. Practical instruction, listening, exchange and other accessible forms can provide rich experiences. No mastery or comprehension is tested in this part.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可享受学习的描述；较低可能涉及近期负担、材料难以访问、没有合适主题或不喜欢书面措辞。你可以喜欢学某种手艺而不爱读非虚构书，也可以为了必要任务学习但并不享受。两者都不等于能力或价值较低。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of enjoying learning. Lower endorsement may involve current load, inaccessible resources, no suitable topic or discomfort with the wording. You might enjoy learning a craft without reading nonfiction, or learn something necessary without enjoying it. Neither implies lower ability or personal value relative to anyone else.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你想弄懂家里一个普通计时器的设置。读说明、听别人解释或在安全条件下按一次示例，都可以帮你接触新内容。你可能享受了解，也可能只想完成设置。这个例子讨论学习时的意愿和感受，不检验哪种方式让你记得最好。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you want to understand the settings of an ordinary household timer. Reading instructions, hearing an explanation or safely trying a demonstrated setting can introduce new material. You may enjoy understanding it or simply want the setup finished. The example concerns interest and experience rather than testing which format gives you the best retention.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我想知道这个功能怎么用，不过今天只学这一步，其他设置以后再看。”也可以说：“我需要一份更容易访问的说明。”你不必报名课程、购买资料或证明自己不断进步。明确主题、条件和可用时间，比“我应该什么都爱学”更可操作。
paragraphs.en: You could say, “I’d like to understand this function, but I’ll learn only this step today and leave the other settings.” Or, “I need instructions in a more accessible format.” No course purchase or continuous demonstration of progress is required. A topic, conditions and available time are more usable than expecting yourself to love learning everything.

paragraphs.zh: 与好奇心相比，本部分更直接询问学习是否令人愉快；四条不足以判断你是否能系统掌握。坚持完成涉及持续推进任务，也可以在没有学习兴趣时出现。学习风格自评询问当前想采用的呈现形式，不可换算为本部分分数，更不能由两者预测成绩或教学效果。
paragraphs.en: Compared with curiosity, this part asks more directly whether learning feels enjoyable; four items cannot determine systematic mastery. Perseverance concerns continuing tasks and can occur without enjoyment of learning. A learning-format reflection asks what presentation is currently wanted. Its score cannot convert to this one or combine with it to predict grades or instructional effectiveness.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，正在照护、休息或处理生计的人可能没有余力学新东西，却已有丰富技能；大量阅读的人也可能误解内容。机会、资源、语言和无障碍条件要分别核对。分数不用于学历、天赋、就业资格或培训资源的分配，也不要求把所有休息变成学习。
paragraphs.en: Someone caring for others, resting or meeting basic demands may have little capacity for new learning while possessing extensive skills. description.zh: 具体区分不吹嘘、谈论自己与争取合理可见度，理解四条自评的有限覆盖，不以沉默证明谦逊。
description.en: Read modest presentation, accomplishments and visibility through a shared project. Full examples without equating silence with moral superiority.

paragraphs.zh: 四条涉及不吹嘘、不被视为傲慢、喜欢在人群中突出和喜欢谈自己。它们偏重自我呈现和可见度，没有直接检查是否承认错误、理解局限或公平归功。完整的谦逊概念比这四条宽，不能把少谈自己自动当成成熟、开放或道德更高。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern not bragging, not being described as arrogant, enjoying standing out and talking about yourself. They emphasise presentation and visibility rather than directly checking acknowledgment of mistakes, limitations or shared credit. Humility is broader than these items; speaking less about yourself cannot automatically establish maturity, openness or moral superiority over other people.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可不突出和不吹嘘的描述；较低可能表示你喜欢表达、工作需要介绍自己或不认同绝对措辞。谈成就不一定夸大，沉默也不一定准确。回答之间有差异时，可以看具体说了什么、依据是什么，而不是选一个谦虚或自大的标签。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of modest presentation and less standing out. Lower endorsement may involve enjoying expression, a role requiring self-introduction or disagreement with absolute language. Describing accomplishments need not exaggerate them, and silence need not be accurate. Differences between answers invite examination of what was said and its evidence rather than a modest-or-arrogant label.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，几个人完成了一份聚会安排，你负责核对地点和时间。向参与者介绍时，可以准确说明自己完成的部分，也注明路线由另一位确认。既不需要把所有功劳揽过来，也不必把自己的实际工作抹去；可见度和准确归功可以同时存在。
paragraphs.en: Suppose a group finishes arrangements for a gathering and you checked the venue and timing. You can accurately describe your portion while noting that someone else confirmed the route. There is no need to claim all the credit or erase your actual work. Visibility and accurate attribution can coexist within the same account of a contribution.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“时间和场地是我核对的，路线由小林确认，其他细节是大家一起决定的。”如果需要介绍成果，也可以清楚列出证据。让自己的贡献被看见，不等于贬低别人；感谢别人也不要求否认自己完成的部分或放弃合理报酬。
paragraphs.en: You could say, “I checked the time and venue, Lin confirmed the route, and we agreed the other details together.” When presenting an accomplishment, name the evidence clearly. Making your contribution visible does not require diminishing others, and acknowledging their work need not deny your part or surrender appropriate compensation for it.

paragraphs.zh: 谦逊表达与诚实有交集，但不突出自己并不自动让内容更真实。公平更涉及权益与一致原则，善意则涉及帮助，几个部分不能互相认证。社交可见度还受文化、角色和访问条件影响，不从本部分推断外向程度、自尊或领导潜力。
paragraphs.en: Modest presentation overlaps with honesty but does not automatically make an account more truthful. Fairness concerns rights and consistency, while kindness concerns help; none certifies the others. Visibility also depends on culture, role and access. This part cannot infer extraversion, self-esteem or leadership potential from how much someone says about themselves.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，一个准备申请机会的人可能需要反复介绍技能，仍然准确承认局限；一个少说话的人也可能没有听取反馈。四条没有独立观察这些行为。分数不能用来要求谁保持低调、放弃署名、接受不合理安排，或判断谁不够自信。

description.zh: 结合普通收纳安排区分原创想法、实用检验和审美欣赏，阅读四条自评而不认证创作或创新能力。
description.en: Explore self-reported original ideas with a practical example and constraints. No artistic-talent, innovation-performance or career-fit verdict.

paragraphs.zh: 四条涉及想出新做法、自认原创思考者、是否被认为有新颖想法，以及产生原创东西的冲动。它们没有要求你完成作品、比较新颖程度或检验效果。这里观察自我印象，不测创造力水平、艺术技能、创新产出或某个想法是否有用。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern new ways of doing things, seeing yourself as original, being considered to have different ideas and an urge to produce something original. They require no completed work, novelty comparison or effectiveness check. This is a self-impression rather than a measure of creative level, artistic skill, innovation output or an idea’s usefulness.

description.zh: 通过可撤回的小安排理解考虑后果与风险偏好，比较担忧和权衡，不用均分保证安全或预测实际行为。
description.en: Explore consequences, timing and reversible choices. Read comparisons and limits without diagnosing worry or certifying the safety of an action.

paragraphs.zh: 四条涉及宁可小心、谨慎选择、尚未想清后果便行动，以及喜欢冒险。它们没有区分风险类别、实际概率和行动后果。喜欢某类尝试并不等于忽略安全，认可小心也不证明识别了所有风险；本部分只是相关自述的有限汇总。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern preferring caution, careful choices, acting before considering consequences and liking risks. They distinguish neither risk categories, actual probabilities nor outcomes. Enjoying some kinds of attempts need not mean disregarding safety, and endorsing caution proves no complete risk assessment. This part is a limited summary of those self-descriptions rather than a safety evaluation.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可先考虑和谨慎的描述；较低可能反映喜欢尝试、熟悉环境或不喜欢绝对化表达。速度和谨慎不总是相反，经验可能让某些检查很快完成。均分不能决定你是否冲动、焦虑或可靠，也不能把不愿冒险排成更高道德等级。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean reflects stronger endorsement of prior consideration and caution. Lower endorsement may involve enjoyment of attempts, familiar settings or disagreement with absolute wording. Speed and care are not always opposites; experience can make some checks quick. This mean cannot establish impulsivity, anxiety or reliability, or rank risk avoidance as morally superior.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你想换一下书桌上轻便收纳盒的位置。可以先确认会不会挡住常用物件、是否容易放回，以及是否影响同用桌面的人，再试一个小范围。这个低风险例子讨论把后果说清，不代表可以用同样简单的步骤处理专业设备或重大决定。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you want to move light storage boxes on a desk. Check whether they block commonly used objects, can be returned easily and affect anyone sharing the surface before trying a small change. This low-risk example concerns naming consequences; the same simple procedure is not sufficient for specialist equipment or consequential decisions requiring relevant expertise.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我先动这一只，保留原来的位置；如果拿取不方便就还原。你这边会受影响吗？”问清条件再行动，与无限推演每种可能不同。别人催促时，也可以说明还缺哪项必要信息，而不是靠“我本来就谨慎”代替具体理由。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I’ll move only this box and keep its original position available; we can restore it if access becomes awkward. Would it affect you?” Checking conditions differs from endlessly rehearsing every possibility. If someone urges speed, name the necessary missing information rather than relying on “I’m a cautious person” as the entire explanation.

paragraphs.zh: 审慎与判断有重叠，后者更广泛询问权衡和不同可能；希望与乐观更涉及未来预期。一个人可以乐观又核查后果，也可以担忧却立即行动。不同均分不形成矛盾人格，更不能由本部分判断“谨慎型”最适合金融、医疗或安全责任。
paragraphs.en: Prudence overlaps with judgment, which asks more broadly about weighing alternatives. Hope and optimism concern expectations. Someone can be optimistic while checking consequences, or worried while acting immediately. Differing means do not create a contradictory personality, and this part cannot establish that a cautious type is suited to finance, medicine or responsibility for safety.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，按已核流程及时行动可能很审慎，继续等待也可能产生新的后果；没有必要信息时停下，则未必是过度小心。真实情境的专业标准、权限和紧急程度始终要独立核对。四条不能估算事故概率、诊断担忧或证明任何安排安全。
paragraphs.en: Acting promptly within a verified procedure may be prudent, while continued waiting can create consequences. Pausing without necessary information need not be excessive caution. paragraphs.en: You could say, “I’m not sure whether this time works. It’s fine to decline without explaining.” If they offer more, attend to the need actually expressed. description.zh: 围绕日常期待、精力和自我印象读四条题，区分热忱、外向与身体条件，不把低能量当人品或心理诊断。
description.en: Read anticipation and energy alongside health, access and rest. Full examples without equating enthusiasm with productivity or personal worth.

paragraphs.zh: 四条涉及醒来期待一天的可能性、期待新一天、被形容为脾气不佳，以及精力不多。它们混合期待、能量和自我印象，没有测身体状况、睡眠或持续投入表现。这里的活力与热忱只是这些描述的汇总，不是生理活力、幸福感或心理健康检查。
paragraphs.en: The four items concern excitement about a day’s possibilities, looking forward to each day, being described as grumpy and having little energy. They mix anticipation, energy and self-impression without measuring health, sleep or sustained performance. Zest here summarises these descriptions rather than examining physical vitality, happiness or psychological health in a person.

paragraphs.zh: 较高均分表示你更认可期待和精力描述；较低可能与休息不足、照护工作、身体条件、近期安排或措辞有关，不等于缺少价值、兴趣或对生活不认真。你可以精力有限却很投入一件重要事，也可以非常兴奋却需要缩小任务。
paragraphs.en: A higher mean indicates stronger endorsement of anticipation and energy. Lower endorsement may relate to inadequate rest, caregiving, physical conditions, current arrangements or wording rather than absent worth, interest or seriousness about life. Someone with limited energy can engage deeply in one important matter, while someone excited may still need a smaller task.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，你有一段可自由安排的时间，想照看一盆植物。你可能愉快地观察新叶，也可能只完成必要浇水后休息。两种安排都可以合适。这个例子不比较谁更积极，也不要求用热情覆盖疲劳；问卷没有检查实际体力、健康或养护技能。
paragraphs.en: Suppose you have a little freely arranged time and want to tend a plant. You might enjoy examining a new leaf or simply do the necessary watering and rest. Either arrangement can be appropriate. This example does not compare positivity or ask enthusiasm to override fatigue; no physical capacity, health or gardening skill has been tested.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我对这件事有兴趣，但今天只做这一小部分，之后需要休息。”也可以说自己目前没有兴致。与别人共同活动时，可以明确自己的节奏，让对方保留不同安排。不必持续显得热情，也不需要承担鼓舞所有人的责任。
paragraphs.en: You could say, “This interests me, but I’ll do only this small part today and then rest.” You can also say that you do not currently feel interested. In shared activities, name your pace while allowing others a different arrangement. You need neither appear continuously enthusiastic nor accept responsibility for keeping everyone else motivated.

paragraphs.zh: 热忱与外向性不同：安静、独处的活动也可以让人投入，喜欢社交也不保证精力充沛。希望与乐观涉及未来预期，坚持完成涉及任务持续，几项不能互换。热情程度不认证生产率、抗压性、职业适配或应承担多少工作。
paragraphs.en: Zest differs from extraversion: quiet, solitary activities can be absorbing, and enjoying company guarantees no abundant energy. Enthusiasm cannot certify productivity, pressure tolerance or career fit, or determine how much work or responsibility someone should take on from others.

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，慢性健康条件、暂时疲劳或高负担可能影响能量题，但并不定义一个人的兴趣和贡献。另一个期待每一天的人也可能需要帮助。四条不能区分原因、诊断情绪或睡眠问题，也不能用高分证明不需要休息、支持或调整安排。
paragraphs.en: Chronic health conditions, temporary fatigue or heavy demands may affect energy items without defining someone’s interests or contributions. Someone who looks forward to each day may also need help. Four items cannot distinguish causes, diagnose mood or sleep conditions, or use high endorsement to establish that rest, support or adjusted arrangements are unnecessary.

paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，记录一个普通片刻：做了什么、是否想参与、实际有多少可用精力，以及是否需要停下。可以只观察已经发生的事，不增加活动、不削减睡眠或休息。记录帮助区分意愿和条件，不预测健康，也不要求分数朝某个方向变化。
paragraphs.en: If you wish, note an ordinary moment: what happened, whether you wanted to participate, the energy actually available and whether a pause was needed.
